senses.gloss: separation, setting apart for a sacred purpose, as the heave-offering (T’rumah, for the priest), or a sacrifice (Korban); also isolation on account of levitical uncleanness, or on acc. of sacredness. Trnsf. the thing set apart, offering, gift. Y. Yoma I, beg. 38ᵃ; Tosef.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:1">Parah III</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 2:1">II</cite>), 1 <cite ref="G00078"><he>זה</he></cite> (<cite ref="U01971"><he>הַ</he></cite>)<he>אַפְרָשָׁתוֹ בטהרה וכ׳</he> (Babli <cite ref="Yoma 8b:1">Yoma 8ᵇ</cite> <he>פרישתו</he>) the one is isolated for the purpose of purification (because of uncleanness), the other for sanctification (for the services of the Day of Atonement).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 7:4:4">Y. Dem. VII, 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>תלוי בה׳</he> depends on the act of setting apart.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:7">B. Kam. V, 7</cite> <he>הַפְרָשַׁת הר סיני</he> the isolation of Mount Sinai prescribed as preparation for the giving of the Law (<cite ref="Exodus 19:13">Ex. XIX, 13</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>אַפְרָשׁוֹת</he>, <he>הַפְרָשׁוֹת</he>. Y. Shek. II, 46ᵈ top <he>שלש א׳</he> three kinds of sacred gifts.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6:5">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> <he>הפרשת וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:3">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <cite ref="Q02026"><he>פָּרָשַׁת</he></cite>.
